risk_if_not_implemented: Without External System Connections, adversaries may move laterally, exfiltrate data or reach systems that should have been isolated from untrusted networks. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), System / Data Compromise (Technical Vector) (R-BC-4), System / Service Compromise (R-EX-7), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Statutory, Regulatory & Contractual Compliance
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the identification and implementation of relevant statutory, regulatory and contractual controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Statutory, Regulatory & Contractual Compliance (CPL-02) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of External System Connections (NET-05.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Third-Party Management
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of third-party management controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Third-Party Management (TPM-02) provides third-party oversight that compensates for the absence of External System Connections (NET-05.1) by extending security obligations contractually and monitoring third-party risk in lieu of direct control. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
